parameters.name: Area
parameters.description:
The prefetch region. Valid values:
- **domestic**: the Chinese mainland only.
- **overseas**: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

If you do not specify this parameter, the prefetch region defaults to the DCDN acceleration region configured for your domain name:

- If the acceleration region of the domain name is **Chinese Mainland Only**, the prefetch region is the Chinese mainland only.
- If the acceleration region of the domain name is **Global**, the prefetch region is global.
- If the acceleration region of the domain name is **Global (Excluding the Chinese Mainland)**, the prefetch region is global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

parameters.name: L2Preload
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to prefetch content directly to L2 nodes. Valid values:

- **true**: The prefetch node hierarchy must include L2 nodes.

- **false** (default): Only origin-layer nodes are prefetched. Origin-layer nodes can be L2 nodes or L3 nodes.

parameters.name: ObjectPath
parameters.description:
The URLs to prefetch. The format is **accelerated domain name/file to prefetch**.
>Separate multiple URLs with line breaks. Each URL can be up to 1,024 characters in length.

parameters.name: QueryHashkey
parameters.description:
This parameter is used when certain rules (such as URL rewrite or parameter filtering) are configured. It specifies whether to enable hashkey query mode when executing prefetch tasks. Valid values:
- false: default mode. This mode is used when this parameter is not specified. The submitted URL is directly used as the hashkey of the prefetched file.
- true: queries the actual hashkey used by the prefetch URL based on the domain name configuration.

parameters.name: WithHeader
parameters.description: The custom prefetch headers. Specify the value in JSON format.
